resources.string: Select the Friends Only Instagram APK you downloaded. This tool passes it locally to Android’s normal installer and records the exact installation result. Android will ask you to confirm installation. It does not access your account or connect to the Internet.
Android must allow this app to request installations. Enable “Allow from this source” for this tool only, then return here. Other security settings do not need to change.
No installation attempted yet. After the attempt, the diagnostic appears here. Nothing is sent automatically. Use Copy or Share to send it yourself.
Copying APK to Android installer… %1$d MiB
Android requires your confirmation. This is not an installation success.
Choose a single .apk file, not an .apkm, .apks or ZIP archive.
APK must be between 1 byte and 1 GiB.
The selected file could not be read. Please choose it again.
Android could not open the installation permission screen.
Android’s confirmation screen could not open. Start a new test from this screen.
The request could not reach Android’s installer. See the local diagnostic below.
Select the downloaded APK to begin.
Only device version and installer error details are included in the result. No passwords, chats, session cookies or account data are read.
